The '''hepatizon laurel''' is an unbreakable head piece that doubles the wearer's base movement speed.

== Obtaining ==
A master-level [[Jeweler|jeweler]] sells it for 10 [[Obol|obols]] and 2 [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/4/hepatizon_laurel.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It gives 1 armor and adds 0.1 movement speed, equal to the player's whole base speed. It is unbreakable and fire-resistant (netherite helmet ID). Because it uses the netherite helmet ID, a blast furnace smelts it into an adamant alloy.
